name: Huang Guan Yin
parentage: Huang Dan (Huang Jin Gui) x Tie Guan Yin
description: 'Yellow Goddess'. A successful modern hybrid cultivar, created by crossing Huang Jin Gui (for aroma) and Tie Guan Yin (for substance). It is an intensely aromatic tea, often presenting a bouquet of powerful floral notes like gardenia and magnolia, and has become a popular 'new style' of Wuyi Rock Oolong.
plantType: Vigorous, productive, early-sprouting hybrid bush (Camellia sinensis var. sinensis).
environment: Bred to be vigorous and adaptable, it is grown in both Anxi and Wuyi. In Wuyi, the rocky terroir adds a mineral foundation to its powerful aroma.
processing: This cultivar was designed for aroma, so the entire processing chain is geared towards preserving its highly volatile floral compounds. Gentle handling is key.
oxidation: Oxidation is kept on the lighter side for an oolong (20-40%) to maintain the freshness and vibrancy of its floral character.
roasting: Roasting, especially for the Yancha style, must be very light and at a low temperature. It is more of a finishing bake to stabilize the tea. A heavy roast would completely destroy the delicate aroma it was bred to produce.
versatility: Moderately versatile. It can be crafted into either a Wuyi or Anxi style, but it will always be a light, intensely fragrant oolong. It lacks the structure for heavy roasting or black tea production.

Wuyi Rock Oolong (New Style).Huang Guan Yin Yancha: A very lightly roasted Yancha where the processing is designed to maximize its explosive floral aroma.

Anxi Oolong (Green Style).Fragrant Anxi Oolong: When processed in Anxi, it is made into a very green, unroasted oolong similar to modern Tie Guan Yin, but even more aromatic.

sensory.aroma: Intense Gardenia, Ginger Lily, Magnolia, very perfume-like
sensory.flavor: Sweet, overwhelmingly floral, with a light body and a clean finish. When from Wuyi, it has a subtle mineral undertone.
sensory.mouthfeel_liquor: Smooth and silky, generally lighter-bodied than traditional Yancha. The liquor is a very bright, pale golden-yellow.
